sections.translation_zh:
在一个多点竞争、替代品易于获得、季度财务结果持续承压的世界里，组织被迫通过新产品与服务、合同承诺或扩大客户群，创造一波又一波的收入模型。

根据 EA 能力团队的对齐方式，EA 的目的可能是成本控制、风险优化、战略开发，或这些因素的变体。即使章程演进，对主要意图与重点的交付期望通常不会消失。这种评估与定位，基于企业参与经济活动的目的，以及设立提供 EA 能力的团队的原因。

正如企业会设法识别创造收入的新模式，企业的产品与服务供应商也会推出不同方法、模型或版本的产品，以推动生态系统变化。基于对企业的评估，EA 团队必须识别并预测企业何时需要开始接触这些新兴技术与概念。EA 能力团队作为主题专家，向利益相关者和决策者提供对新兴概念、技术与模式的评审。此类评审文件应与设立 EA 能力工作的目的保持一致。

企业架构师的一项关键优势，是能够审视所讨论的系统，而不偏向高管与实施者、客户或支持人员、安全或合规官或开发人员，也不偏向技术或时间因素。当企业架构师呈现平衡的观点，并以理由支撑——回应未来需求、说明所采用的权衡条件、考虑公司文化——团队通常会放下情感偏好，趋向共同目标。利益相关者总是希望从企业架构师那里获得这种洞察，以验证自己走在正确道路上，或以最小的沉没成本快速失败并纠正方向。期望还包括企业架构师提供诚实的影响评估与风险缓解备选方案。经验表明，提出通常被视为最令人不安的问题，会在企业中引发一连串积极变化。

EA 团队应定期评估企业对采用 EA 实践或新技术的准备情况——这是价值交付的下一次跃升。这种评估有助于提供 EA 能力的团队把握扩展章程的时机。抛开对章程扩展与成熟度的雄心，目标是确保提供 EA 能力的团队与生态系统及业务需求保持相关性和同步。

source_units.text_en: 12.2. Start with Purpose

In a world of multi-point competition, ease of availability of substitutes, and continuous pressure of quarterly fiscal results, organizations are forced to create waves of revenue models via new products and services, contractual commitments, or expansion of customer base.

Based on the alignment of the EA Capability team, the purpose for EA could be cost control, risk optimization, strategy development, or variants of these factors. Even if the charter evolves, expectation to deliver on the primary intent and focus generally does not go away. This assessment and grounding is based on the purpose for which the enterprise is engaged in the economic activity as well as why the team providing the EA Capability is formed.

Just like how the enterprise approaches identifying new models to generate revenue, suppliers of products and services to the enterprise also come up with different methods, models, or versions of their products to force changes to the ecosystem. Based on the assessment of the enterprise, the EA team will have to identify and project out when the enterprise will have to start engagement with these emergent technologies and concepts. The EA Capability team acts as subject matter experts in providing a review of the emergent concepts, technologies, and patterns to the stakeholders and
decisions-makers. Such review documents should align with the purpose for which the EA Capability effort was created.

One of the key advantages an Enterprise Architect has is the ability to look at the system under discussion without any bias to the views of the executives and implementers, customers or support personnel, and security or compliance officers or developers, technology or time. When an Enterprise Architect presents a balanced view, supported with rationale addressing future needs, trade-off conditions applied, accounting for culture of the company, teams generally gravitate towards common goals setting aside emotional favorites. Stakeholders invariably want this insight from the Enterprise Architects to validate that they are on the right path or to fail fast and course correct with the least sunk cost. The expectation is also that the Enterprise Architect provides an honest impact assessment and risk mitigation alternatives. Experience has shown that raising what could normally be perceived as the most uncomfortable set of questions instigates a chain of positive changes in the enterprise.

The EA team should create a periodic assessment of readiness the enterprise has for adopting EA practices or new technologies – the next leap of value delivery. This assessment helps the team providing the EA Capability to time the case for expansion of the charter. Ambitions for growth in charter as well as maturity aside, the goal is to ensure that the team providing the EA Capability stays relevant and current with the ecosystem and business needs.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: EA目的应从企业经济活动目的和能力团队组建原因定位，章程演进不自动消除主要交付意图。

evidence.quote_en: purpose for which the enterprise is engaged in the economic activity

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 平衡建议需明确未来需求、权衡条件、文化、影响与风险替代方案；架构师的独立洞察不等于自行替利益相关者决策。

evidence.quote_en: without any bias

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 定期评估企业采用EA实践或新技术的就绪度，用于判断扩展章程时机与持续相关性。

evidence.quote_en: periodic assessment of readiness

sections.title_en: 12.3. Trusted Advisor and Instigator of Change
sections.title_zh: 12.3. 可信顾问与变革推动者
sections.translation_zh:
如今多数组织并非在启动蓝海战略（关于蓝海战略，见 Kim 与 Mauborgne 的《蓝海战略》；Kim & Mauborgne, 2005）；不要把这与绿地工作混为一谈。有些工作在企业内部可能属于绿地，但该模式可能已在别处得到解决。这种交叉借鉴是有价值的，EA 团队将扮演可信顾问的角色。他们的若干举措是解决某个业务问题的第 n+1 次尝试。在此类场景中，当解决方案备选评估或解决方案开发工作开始时，现代精益方法并不利于审视企业的更广阔语境。企业架构师理解企业内外部的相互依赖，能够引导团队建立适当的隔离点。EA 团队应清晰、持续地沟通企业的共同愿景，以及所有利益相关者群体如何共同支持该愿景。把愿景的焦点从典型的由内而外视角转向由外而内视角，可以提升关键决策者的思维层次。灌输“隔离点”思维以管理变更、管理对市场动态的快速响应，会带来对人的信任，并因此带来对提供 EA 能力的团队的信任。

专注于并交付关键组织转型的 EA 能力团队，在统计上比专注于标准、参考架构、流程与治理结构的团队更成功。这种需求有时会给提供 EA 能力的团队带来规模问题。为实现规模化，成功的 EA 团队采用了一些技术，例如把影响评估问题、权衡考虑等典型工作进行“特许经营”。要采用这类技术，流程必须定义良好。

当落地组织变革或进行特许经营的机会并不直接可得时，开发和发布“观点”文件已被证明是一种成功的影响变革技术。监测并评估哪些观点被阅读、被谁阅读，可以呈现利益相关者的兴趣。跟踪这些利益相关者所发起的变更，会带来同侪层面的认可。沟通并分享举措的功劳，以把团队确立为变革推动者。

source_units.text_en: 12.3. Trusted Advisor and Instigator of Change

Most organizations today are not starting blue ocean strategies;[1] Do not confuse this with green field work. Some efforts may be green field within an enterprise, but the pattern may have been solved elsewhere. There is value in such cross-pollination, and the EA team will play the role of a trusted advisor. Several of their initiatives are the n+1th attempt to solve a business problem. In such scenarios, when solution alternative evaluation or solution development efforts begin, modern lean methodologies do not lend themselves to view the broader context of the enterprise. An Enterprise Architect understands inter-dependencies within and outside the enterprise and can guide the teams to create appropriate points of isolation. An EA team should communicate clearly and continuously the shared vision for the enterprise and how all stakeholder groups are coming together behind that vision. Moving the focus of the vision from the typical inside-out view to an outside-in view elevates the thinking of key decision-makers. Instilling the thinking for points of isolation to manage change and to manage rapid response to market dynamics brings trust in the people and, hence, to the team providing the EA Capability.

EA Capability teams that focus and deliver key organizational transformations are statistically more successful than teams that focus on standards, reference architectures, processes, and governance structures. Such a demand at times has caused scale issues for the team providing the EA Capability. To scale, successful EA teams have employed techniques like franchising typical work such as impact assessment questions and trade-off considerations. To employ such techniques, the process should be well defined.
When engagement opportunities to land organizational changes or to franchise are not directly available, the development and publication of point of view documents has proven to be a successful

technique to influence change. Monitoring and assessing which points of view get read and by whom presents the stakeholder interest. Tracking the changes those stakeholders initiate results in peer-level acceptance. Communicate and share the credits of initiatives to establish the team as agents of change.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 架构师要识别企业内外依赖并设置适当隔离点；隔离服务于变更和快速响应，不得切断必要跨域联系。

evidence.quote_en: appropriate points of isolation

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 统计性成功陈述应理解为本源文经验性主张；skills应优先支持组织转型与可复制影响评估，同时保留标准、参考架构和治理的必要性。

evidence.quote_en: focus and deliver key organizational transformations

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 观点文件的阅读、读者及其发起变更可作为利益相关者兴趣与同侪接受证据，不能单独作为价值因果证明。

evidence.quote_en: Tracking the changes those stakeholders initiate

sections.translation_zh:
随着业务动态变化，组织会经历变革——无论是否由提供 EA 能力的团队推动。EA 能力团队必须跟踪外部生态系统的变化，并创建观点文件。为维持并发展 EA 能力，领导者应为决策者准备一份建议清单，说明需要哪些转型，以使企业跟上或领先于生态系统变化。有些转型可能需要改变运营模式，有些则只需调整产品组合。观点文件的覆盖范围可包括运营模式变化、技术采用、风险降低、所提供服务的性质，或需要缓解的权衡标准。根据章程，EA 领导者应向决策者指出，某种热潮何时会变成必需，以及采用成本与失败风险何时达到适当平衡。

新千年以来的趋势是，产品与服务日益复杂，并与潜在当前及未来竞争者形成独特差异。其中一些产品与服务降低了对某些技能组合的依赖，另一些则需要新的专业技能。此外，许多产品与服务正通过与利基伙伴的深度协作来开发。协作成本持续下降，服务提供商的多样性不断增长。组织一直在收缩核心、扩展边缘。在这样的时代，成功因素与胜任力驱动战略，其基础是企业所执行的活动集合彼此契合的程度。当 EA 创建企业地图——包含能力、流程、技术、培训、投资流的深度——跨团队与跨战略主题的运营契合度就会显现。同样，正如向业务提供的建议，定期构建 EA 能力变革论证，能让团队更新技能并领先于企业其他部分。

一般而言，企业计划既不质疑为某项工作所做的假设，也不清晰论证为何必须做某事以及何时做。多数业务论证基于企业花费资源的可负担性。EA 路线图则呈现做某事的理由，并提出备选方案——每种方案都有其影响——把假设追溯到预测结果。在这种方法中，变更的难易程度、随时间推移对变更的验证，以及对“最终形态”的评估，都可以清晰地描绘出来，以指导组织、产品或流程变革。

source_units.text_en: 12.4. Change Management

As business dynamics change, organizations undergo change – informed by the team providing the EA Capability or otherwise. It is necessary for the EA Capability team to track changes in the external ecosystem and create point of view documents. To sustain and grow the EA Capability, the Leader should prepare a list of recommendations for the decision-makers about transformation(s) needed to keep the enterprise abreast or ahead of ecosystem changes. Some transformations may require a change in operating model and some just an alteration in product mix. The range of coverage in point of view documents may include changes in operating model, technology adoption, risk reduction, or the nature of services offered or trade-off criteria to mitigate. Depending on the charter, the EA Leader should indicate to the decision-maker when a hype would become a necessity or cost of adoption and risk of failure is balanced appropriately.

The trend since the new millennium is increased complexity of products and services that uniquely differentiate from potential current and future competitors. Some of these products and services reduce dependency on certain skill sets and some require new and specialized skills. Also, several products and services are being developed using deep collaboration with niche partners. The cost of collaboration has been falling, and diversity of service providers has been growing. Organizations have been shrinking the core and expanding at the edges. In such an era, success factors and competence drives the strategy based on how well the sets of activities performed by the enterprise dovetail with one another. When EA creates an enterprise map – that has the depth of capabilities, processes, technologies, training, investment flows – operational fit across teams and themes of strategy realization come to light. Once again, just like the advice provided to business, periodic development of the case for change of the EA Capability informs the team to update its skills and to stay ahead of rest of the enterprise.

In general, enterprise plans do not question the assumptions made for an effort nor do they justify clearly why something has to be done and when. Most of the business cases are based on the affordability of the enterprise to spend its resources. EA roadmaps present the reason for something to be done and present the alternatives – each with implications – tracing assumptions to predictive outcomes. In this approach, ease of change, validating change as time passes, and an assessment of “what the end looks like” can be painted clearly to guide organizational, product, or process change.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 观点文件和生态监测用于向决策者说明何时需要转型、改变运营模式或产品组合，以及采用成本与失败风险的权衡。

evidence.quote_en: when a hype would become a necessity

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 路线图呈现备选及影响，把假设追溯至预测结果，支持随时间验证变更和描述最终形态。

evidence.quote_en: tracing assumptions to predictive outcomes

sections.translation_zh:
为维持并成熟 EA 能力，领导者应评估执行能力，并与发起人验证章程或范围变化的可能性：

- **职能为中心的 EA**——重点将放在适当的业务与流程架构、技术采购与运营成本上。
- **战略为中心的 EA 能力**——实现可持续的战略优势，把技术用作业务加速器，平衡由内而外与由外而内的视角。无论对齐性质如何，都需要团队中拥有不同思维与执行风格的成员（观星者、人类学家与规划者）。
- **IT 为中心的团队**——挑战将围绕 CIO 的优先事项：降低运营成本、满足业务需求的敏捷性、使生态系统跟上技术更新，等等。

这些人的风格在企业能力的不同层面形成互补：战略层面（高管参与）、价值增加层面（管理企业构成）与协调层面（共同服务）。正如壳牌石油一位前 CEO 所说：“人就是差异所在。”EA——尽管同样关乎业务战略与技术——是以人为中心的。要发展能力，领导者的动机应建立在人员参与之上。领导者的职责是培育这三种风格，并为具备这些风格的人找到平衡，使其遵循一套共同的原则与信念，即：连通性、包容性与相关性。

图12-1：可持续的EA。图内结构与文字见独立源图记录。

source_units.text_en: 12.5. Sustaining and Maturing
To sustain and mature the EA Capability, the Leader should assess the capacity to execute and validate the possibility of change in charter or scope with the sponsors:
• A function-centric EA – focus would be on appropriate business and process architecture, technology sourcing, and cost of operations

• A strategy-centric EA Capability – enablement of sustainable strategic advantage, leveraging technology as a business accelerator, balancing inside-out and outside-in perspectives. Irrespective of the nature of alignment, there is a need to have the members of a team with varied styles of thinking and execution (star gazers, anthropologists, and planners)

• An IT-centric team – the challenges are going to be pivoted on CIO priorities: reducing cost of operations and agility to meet the business needs, keeping the ecosystem current with technological updates, and so on

The styles of these people complement the enterprise capabilities at strategic (executive engagement), value addition (managing composition of the enterprise), and coordination (common services) levels. As one of the former CEOs of Shell Oil puts it: “people are the difference”. EA – as much as it is about business strategy and technology – is people-centric. To grow the capability, the Leader’s motivations should be grounded on people engagement. It is the responsibility of the Leader to nurture these three styles and find a balance for the people possessing them to be executing on a common set of principles and beliefs, namely: connectedness, inclusivity, and relevance.
Figure 12-1: Sustainable EA

sections.title_en: 12.5.1. How to Engage and Promote Value Execution of the Internal Stakeholders
sections.title_zh: 12.5.1. 如何让内部利益相关者参与并促进价值执行
sections.translation_zh:
拥有充分赞助的 EA 能力团队在获取新参与机会时没有成本或间接费用。挑战在于，EA 能力的买方群体是预先确定的——除非企业决定扩大其足迹。在这种情况下，重点应放在留存与来自同一批客户的重复业务上。可以运用公共关系与项目管理手册中的若干技术来实现这一点。进行定量与定性度量，用贴近 EA 服务主要与次要消费者的语言，沟通 EA 能力团队交付的每一小项改进与价值增加。为维持 EA 能力，你需要关注 EA 活动为何、何时以及如何执行，以及提供 EA 能力的团队所产出的成果如何被消费、由谁消费。

当赞助具有挑战性时，重点应放在软性推销上，就像宣传退休或保险计划的必要性一样。赞助不足时采用的成功方法之一是：制定路线图与实施计划，附上合理的财务预测，并在年度预算编制启动时向高管呈报。花时间从年度业绩、分析师电话会议以及前 20 大项目的目标陈述中理解或推断企业的战略与方向。利用这种理解，至少为一个关键业务单元构建路线图：如果重点是提升销售，就为市场营销与销售部门做；如果重点是运营成本管理，就为运营团队做。获取赞助的成本很高。在重启场景中，成本要高出数倍。

在 EA 中，没有正确、错误或唯一的方法。EA 迫使自身及其消费者几乎总是考虑权衡；迫使他们查看数据，以帮助在混沌中导航。它实现的是消除对可重复流程与成本优化的偏见。它把焦点带到考虑所有可行备选方案上。组织领导者思维的改变，就是定性价值增加的一个例子。团队中的所有架构师都应考虑制定一套与当前战略和运营挑战同步的权衡标准。提供可直接决策的备选方案，会带来更好的赞助与对 EA 团队的接受度。

根据组织文化，如果章程不清晰，EA 团队应质疑一些赞助假设，并问自己：

- 提供 EA 能力的团队应拥有何种财务控制权？

  观点存在差异——从仅管理 EA 的运营成本（或把提供 EA 能力的团队视为资本支出），到赞助技术研究工作，再到验证每项举措与组织目标的相关性和一致性。

- 治理是否应同时作为架构产出与项目符合性的反馈机制？
- 尽管本文档前面建议在能够实现并迭代即时价值的范围内使用 TOGAF ADM，但鉴于企业文化，这是否是正确方法？
- 鉴于内外部力量，EA 运营模式应由目标架构驱动，还是由目标运营模式驱动？
- 规划应基于能力，还是基于流程效率与提供给客户的差异化？
- 根据企业的收费模式，各项目执行团队可在多大程度上为 EA 参与付费？

一项必要的定期工作，是把企业和提供 EA 能力的团队的关注点，从文档严谨性与静态分析转向运营与战略业务成果。经验表明，这种转变总会带来赞助增加以及对 EA 资源的需求增加。

source_units.text_en: 12.5.1. How to Engage and Promote Value Execution of the Internal Stakeholders
A team providing the EA Capability with adequate sponsorship has no cost or overhead to acquire new engagements. The challenge is that the buyer base of EA Capability is predefined – unless the

enterprise decides to broaden its footprint. In this case, the focus should be about retention and repeat business from the same set of customers. Several techniques can be employed from the public relations and project management playbook to achieve this. Measure quantitatively and qualitatively to communicate every small improvement and value addition the EA Capability team has delivered in terms that are close to the primary and secondary consumer of the EA services. To sustain EA Capability, you need to focus on why, when, and how EA activities are performed and how the output produced by the team providing the EA Capability is being consumed and by whom.

When the sponsorship is challenging, the focus should be on soft-selling, like communicating the need to subscribe to a retirement or insurance plan. One of the successful methods employed when sponsorship has been insufficient is to develop a roadmap and an implementation plan with reasonable financial projections and present them to executives when annual budget preparations are being initiated. Take time to understand or infer the strategy and direction of the enterprise from annual results, analyst calls, and objective statements of top 20 projects. Use this understanding to build a roadmap for at least one key business unit: if the focus is on improving sales, do it for marketing and sales; if the focus is operational cost management, create one for the operations team. There is heavy cost on acquiring sponsors. In a re-boot scenario, the cost is multi-fold higher.

In EA, there is no right, wrong, or singularity of approach. EA forces itself and its consumers to almost always think of trade-offs; it forces them to look at data to help navigate the chaos. What it achieves is removing the bias for repeatable process and cost optimization. It brings focus to consider all viable alternatives. The change in thinking of organizational leadership is an example of qualitative value addition. All architects in the team should think of developing a set of trade-off criteria that is current with strategic and operational challenges. Providing decision-ready alternatives creates better sponsorship and acceptance of an EA team.
Depending on the organizational culture, the EA team should question a few sponsorship assumptions, if the charter is not clear, and ask itself:
• What kind of financial control should the team providing the EA Capability have?

There are differences in views – from managing just EA’s operational cost (or considering the team providing the EA Capability as capital expense) to sponsoring technology research effort, all the way to validating every initiative for relevance and alignment to organizational goals.
• Should governance be used as a feedback mechanism for both architecture output and project conformance?

• Even though it is suggested earlier in this document to use the TOGAF ADM to the extent that immediate value can be realized and iterated, is it the right approach, given the culture of the enterprise?
• Given internal and external forces, should the EA operating model be target architecture or target operating model-driven?
• Should the planning be based on capabilities or process efficiencies and differentiation offered to customers?
• Depending on the charging model in the enterprise, what is the extent to which each of the project execution teams can be taxed for EA engagement?

One of the necessary periodic exercises is to move the focus of the enterprise and the team providing the EA Capability from rigor of documentation and static analysis to operational and strategic business outcomes. Experience shows that such a shift invariably results in increased sponsorship and demand for EA resources.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 充分赞助下重点是留存和重复价值；买方群体预定义，扩大足迹需企业明确决定。

evidence.quote_en: no cost or overhead to acquire new engagements

semantic_rules.statement_zh: EA以数据和权衡呈现可行替代，避免把某一流程或成本优化路径宣布为唯一正确答案。

evidence.quote_en: no right, wrong, or singularity of approach

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 定期把关注点从文档严谨与静态分析移向运营、战略结果；这是价值沟通和资源需求调整的治理问题。

evidence.quote_en: from rigor of documentation and static analysis to operational and strategic business outcomes

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 赞助不足时应质疑财务控制、治理反馈、ADM文化适配、运营模式、规划基础和项目计费等假设；这些是待决问题，不是默认答案。

evidence.quote_en: What kind of financial control

sections.translation_zh:
企业中有些事是人人有责的——客户目标、质量目标与 EA。每位管理者或产品开发者的决策都会影响企业目标。从供应商处采购服务或产品，会在企业自身的目标与运营模式同服务提供者的目标与运营模式之间引入摩擦。除了参与经济活动本身的风险，企业现在还在叠加风险因素。鉴于 EA 能降低风险影响这一前提，应定期评估服务提供者的目标。

随着 TOGAF ADM 周期通过迭代走向成熟，开发一套行动手册，以便在并不直接受提供 EA 能力的团队控制的新参与者群体中复制成功。提供 EA 能力的团队能否成功并持续，取决于 EA 能力团队下一代人员——即团队所辅导的学员——以及发起人的信念。把 EA 的知识与实践传播到企业新的部分，从来不会损害提供 EA 能力的团队。

导师辅导是实现成熟、并在企业其他部分复制 EA 工作的方法之一。成为可信顾问本身就是一种导师辅导。必须注意区分培养初任架构师与辅导组织领导者。架构工作很可能发生在企业不同部门，由没有架构师头衔或属于企业外部的人员执行。与此类热衷者建立深入、持续的互动。识别架构工作的哪些方面将成为企业的差异化因素与知识产权。推广这些差异化因素，以及开发和维护这些资产的人。

识别企业用于培养人才的年度培训周期或在线课程。围绕特定主题设计 20 至 30 分钟的有针对性演讲，以形成学习管道。根据企业规模，用定期架构峰会增强这些培训主题。另一种方法是考虑让个人参加技术专业或架构师认证。注意人们追求的是哪些认证——架构流程还是架构开发。把架构方法与实践的专长，与架构思想领导力区分开来。

source_units.text_en: 12.6. Building Community and Mentoring

There are a few things in the enterprise that are everybody’s business – customer goals, quality goals, and EA. Every manager or product developer’s decision has an impact on the goals of the enterprise. Procuring services or products from a supplier introduces friction between objectives and the operating model of the enterprise and that of the service provider. In addition to the risk of engaging in an economic activity, the enterprise is now compounding its risk factors. Given the premise that EA reduces risk impact, objectives of service providers should be assessed periodically.

As the TOGAF ADM cycle is explored in iterations to achieve maturity, develop a playbook to replicate the success with new sets of players, not directly under the team providing the EA Capability’s control. Success and sustainability of the team providing the EA Capability is determined by the belief of the next generation of personnel in the EA Capability team - the mentees of the team and that of the sponsor. Spreading the knowledge and practice of EA to new parts of the enterprise has never hurt the team providing the EA Capability.

Mentoring is one of the techniques to employ to achieve maturity and replication of EA efforts in other parts of the enterprise. Being a trusted advisor is a form of mentoring. Care must be taken to differentiate grooming budding architects and coaching organizational leaders. It is likely that architecture work happens in different parts of the enterprise, with people who don’t have an architect title or are external to the enterprise. Develop deep and continuous engagement with such enthusiasts. Identify what aspects of the architecture work would become differentiators and intellectual property of the enterprise. Promote the differentiators and those who are developing and curating those assets.

Identify the annual training cycles or online courses that the enterprise employs to build talent. Build targeted 20 to 30-minute talks on specific topics to create a pipeline of learning. Depending on the size of the enterprise, augment such training topics with periodic architecture summits. Another approach is consideration for individuals going through technical specialty or architect certifications. Pay attention to what certifications are being pursued – architecture processes or architecture development. Differentiate expertise in architecture method and practice from thought leadership with architecture.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 把成功做法形成可复制行动手册，扩展到不直接受核心团队控制的新参与者，同时建立下一代人员与发起人信任。

evidence.quote_en: develop a playbook to replicate the success

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 区分培养架构师与辅导组织领导者；识别无架构头衔或外部参与者的架构工作及可成为企业差异化/知识产权的资产。

evidence.quote_en: differentiate grooming budding architects and coaching organizational leaders

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 培训管道可用20–30分钟专题分享、峰会和认证组合，认证架构流程与架构开发专长、思想领导力需分开记录。

evidence.quote_en: 20 to 30-minute talks

sections.translation_zh:
简而言之，为 EA 能力创建标准操作程序与执行流程。缺乏互操作性或无缝集成的工具，会留下人工操作与版本不同步的空间。版本不同步会导致精力用于清理信息，而不是交付洞察与智能。作为领导者，应花时间与精力获得合适的存储库来承载 EA 数据，并考虑互操作性、减少下游工作的返工。

必须注意区分项目文档存储库与 EA 存储库。EA 制品与项目制品相互供给。任何要求在不同工具中重建部分工作的工具或流程，都会导致采用失败。

应考虑的文件与存储库类别包括：

- 用于架构的图表与可视化工具
- 用于解决方案与技术设计的图表与可视化工具
- 标准目录（行业、业务领域、企业）以及用于理解标准细节的查询工具
- 就绪度与成熟度评估及进展管理工具
- 路线图管理工具，可能具备时间序列分析能力
- 财务与投资分析工具
- 架构演进管理工具

尾注[1]：关于蓝海战略，参见Kim和Mauborgne《Blue Ocean Strategy: How to Create Uncontested Marketspace and Make the Competition Irrelevant》（Kim & Mauborgne, 2005），该注对应第12.3节。

source_units.text_en: 12.7. Tools and Techniques

In simple terms, create a standard operating procedure and execution process for the EA Capability. Tools without interoperability or seamless integration leave room for manual efforts and out-of-sync

versions. Out-of-sync versions result in effort cleansing the information instead of effort delivering insights and intelligence. As a Leader, spend time and effort to get the right repository to hold the EA data with considerations for interoperability and reducing rework for downstream work.

Care must be taken to differentiate a project document repository and an EA repository. EA artifacts and project artifacts feed each other. Any tool or process that requires part of the work to be recreated in different tools will lead to failure of adoption.
Categories of documents and repositories to consider are:
• Diagram and visualizing tools for architecture
• Diagram and visualizing tools for solution and technology design
• Standards catalogs (industry, business domain, enterprise) and look-up tools to understand the details of the standard
• Readiness and maturity assessments and progression management tools
• Roadmap management tools, potentially with time series analysis capabilities
• Financial and investment analysis tools
• Architecture evolution management tools
Endnotes
[1] For more on blue ocean strategy, see Blue Ocean Strategy: How to Create Uncontested Marketspace and Make the Competition Irrelevant, by Kim and Mauborgne (see Kim & Mauborgne, 2005).

sections.title_en: Part 5: Mapping to the TOGAF Framework
sections.translation_zh: 第五部分：映射到TOGAF框架。The Open Group。

source_units.text_en: Part 5: Mapping to the TOGAF Framework
The Open Group

sections.translation_zh:
本文档描述的 EA 领导者方法可映射到 TOGAF 框架的两个核心要素：架构开发方法（ADM）与 TOGAF 内容框架。

本文档所述活动沿 ADM 的预备阶段展开；预备阶段是 TOGAF ADM 的一条定制路径。这一旅程凸显了 TOGAF 迭代概念的一个实践示例：在正确的详细程度上回答正确的问题，以支撑下一个问题与决策。

这些问题的答案所代表的信息，可与 TOGAF 内容框架的内容对齐。信息如何呈现，取决于：

- EA 团队如何组织
- 团队使用的工具
- EA 存储库的性质
- EA 能力如何执行信息管理

高绩效团队会对信息管理（EA 内容框架）采取更严谨的方法，采用更正式的架构描述学科（EA 内容元模型），并使用专门构建的建模与存储库管理工具（EA 存储库）。更多细节见第 8.4 节。

source_units.text_en: 13. Mapping to the TOGAF Framework
The EA Leader’s approach described in this document can be mapped to two central elements in the TOGAF framework: the Architecture Development Method (ADM) and the TOGAF Content Framework.

The activity described in this document follows the ADM’s Preliminary Phase; the Preliminary Phase is a customized path through the TOGAF ADM. This journey highlights a practical example of the TOGAF concept of iteration, answering the correct question at the right level of detail to inform the next question and decision.
The answers to the questions represent information that may be aligned with the contents of the TOGAF Content Framework. How this information is rendered is dependent upon:
• How the EA team is structured
• The tools it uses
• The nature of the EA Repository
• How the EA Capability performs information management

High-functioning teams will take a more rigorous approach to information management (EA Content Framework), employ a more formal architecture description discipline (EA Content Metamodel), and utilize purpose-built modeling and repository management tools (EA Repository). For more detail, see Section 8.4.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 预备阶段是定制ADM旅程，以当前问题所需详细程度回答，并把答案接到下一问题与决策。

evidence.quote_en: correct question at the right level of detail

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 高绩效团队会提高信息管理、架构描述和建模/存储库工具的正式程度；正式化不代表所有组织必须同一元模型。

evidence.quote_en: more formal architecture description discipline

sections.title_zh: 13.1. 映射到 TOGAF ADM 阶段

预备阶段被设计为 TOGAF ADM 的一段定制旅程。这一旅程以 EA 开发的最佳实践为前提。ADM 不是线性流程模型，而是一种逻辑方法，它把关键活动步骤放在一起，以理解活动之间的关系并澄清信息流。在表 13-1 中，若干 TOGAF ADM 阶段被迭代进入。“部分”表示仅开展回答当前问题所需的程度。后续架构工作可做更多阐述。 这一旅程的图形化表示见图 10-3。图 10-3 聚焦阶段 A。它表明，为完成阶段 A，需要在阶段 B、C、D 中开展一定量的工作。ADM 用于开发 EA。用 ADM 为 EA 能力、财务能力、组合或组织战略做架构，并无区别。我们是在用 ADM 的概念支持两种不同的活动。ADM 阶段中步骤的应用，受支持 EA 能力这一语境的限制。 **表 13-1：活动与关键交付物** | 主题 | 映射到 TOGAF ADM 阶段 | |---|---| | 企业语境与 EA 语境（见第 4 章） | 部分战略层阶段 B。

EA 能力特有的 EA 语境：目标。 | | EA 能力的业务目标（见第 5 章） | 能力层阶段 A。
针对 EA 能力：提供初始目标与目的；选择参考 EA 能力与成熟度模型；候选 EA 能力；候选运营模型；EA 能力差距与优先级路线图。 | | 架构治理（见第 6 章） | 部分分段/能力层阶段 B。
针对企业：企业风险管理模型；治理模型。
针对 EA 能力：风险管理模型；治理模型；扩展候选运营模型以纳入 EA 治理；初始架构分区模型；追溯到 EA 能力目标。 | | 与其他框架的对齐（见第 7 章） | 部分能力层阶段 B，以及部分阶段 C（数据）。
针对企业：关键框架的参考模型；关键框架的能力评估。

针对 EA 能力：EA 内容框架；EA 内容元模型；视点库；架构存储库模型；追溯到 EA 能力目标；初始 EA 内容框架与架构存储库差距。 | | EA 团队的组织模型（见第 9 章） | 部分能力层阶段 B。
针对 EA 能力：EA 组织模型；选择参考 EA 技能框架；与企业职位头衔和角色的初步对齐；EA 内容框架与初始架构存储库的初步问责矩阵；组织差距与优先级路线图。 | | 流程模型（见第 10 章） | 部分能力层阶段 B；能力层阶段 C（应用）与能力层阶段 D。
针对企业：突出 EA 能力与其所支持企业流程之间接触点的流程模型；关键流程与组织的绩效矩阵；EA 内容框架与组织的问责矩阵。
针对 EA 能力：流程模型；架构存储库应用模型；EA 内容框架与架构存储库应用架构的矩阵；流程与架构存储库差距及优先级路线图。 | | 创建 EA 能力路线图（见第 11 章） | 能力层阶段 E。
创建路线图，通过以下方面的变化突出 EA 能力的发展：组织模型；流程模型；EA 内容框架；架构存储库。
针对 EA 能力：把路线图追溯到 EA 能力目标。 | | 建立并演进 EA 能力（见第 12 章） | 能力层阶段 F 与能力层阶段 G。
针对企业：把 EA 能力路线图转化为实施与迁移计划。

source_units.text_en: 13.1. Mapping to TOGAF ADM Phases

The Preliminary Phase is designed as a customized journey of the TOGAF ADM. This journey is predicated on the best practice of developing EA. The ADM is not a linear process model; rather it is a logical method that places key activity steps together for the purpose of understanding the relationship of activity and clarifying information flow. In Table 13-1 several TOGAF ADM phases are entered iteratively. Partial indicates work only to the extent needed to answer the question at hand. More elaboration can be done in subsequent architecture work.

For a graphical representation of this journey see Figure 10-3. The graphic in Figure 10-3 focuses on Phase A. It highlights that in order to complete Phase A, some amount of work is needed in Phases B, C, and D. The ADM is used to develop the EA. There is no difference between exercising the ADM to architect an EA Capability, a finance capability, a portfolio, or an organizational strategy. We are using the concepts of ADM to support two different activities. Application of steps in ADM phases is limited by the context of supporting the EA Capability.

operational_analysis.unknown_handling_zh: 所有实际企业输入、授权、人员评分、价值、符合性及豁免均需独立事实与责任人，缺失时保持unknown/not-assessed，不因制品被生成而填为approved、compliant或effective。
diagram_requirements_zh: 每个节点绑定模型实体，边绑定命名关系及方向。
基线、目标、过渡、备选场景独立标识；图相似不证明状态相同。
视图绑定利益相关者关注点和视点规则，图中内容追溯来源与版本。
组织角色图不自动表示人事汇报线、财政批准权或所有问题的决定权。
工作包与路线图图示必须显示依赖、时点和治理检查点，不能以布局关系代替模型关系。
operational_analysis.boundary_with_G249_zh: G184解释为什么需要EA能力、如何授权/组织/治理/衡量价值；G249角色技能可用于人员与能力发展，但人员职业熟练度不得直接当作AI工具权限或自动决策级别。G249具体规则由其独立审查负责。
